params.sql:
select
  case when i.[Security ID] is not null and trim(cast(i.[Security ID] as string)) <> '' then i.[Security ID] else b.[Security ID] end as [Security ID],
  case when i.[Security] is not null and trim(cast(i.[Security] as string)) <> '' then i.[Security] else b.[Security] end as [Security],
  case when i.[As of Date] is not null and trim(cast(i.[As of Date] as string)) <> '' then i.[As of Date] else b.[As of Date] end as [As of Date],
  case when i.[Process Date] is not null and trim(cast(i.[Process Date] as string)) <> '' then i.[Process Date] else b.[Process Date] end as [Process Date],
  case when i.[Trans. Type] is not null and trim(cast(i.[Trans. Type] as string)) <> '' then i.[Trans. Type] else b.[Trans. Type] end as [Trans. Type],
  case when i.[Trans. No.] is not null and trim(cast(i.[Trans. No.] as string)) <> '' then i.[Trans. No.] else b.[Trans. No.] end as [Trans. No.],
  case when i.[Broker No.] is not null and trim(cast(i.[Broker No.] as string)) <> '' then i.[Broker No.] else b.[Broker No.] end as [Broker No.],
  case when i.[Shares Issued] is not null and trim(cast(i.[Shares Issued] as string)) <> '' then i.[Shares Issued] else b.[Shares Issued] end as [Shares Issued],
  case when i.[Shares Retired] is not null and trim(cast(i.[Shares Retired] as string)) <> '' then i.[Shares Retired] else b.[Shares Retired] end as [Shares Retired],
  case when i.[Issued & Outstanding] is not null and trim(cast(i.[Issued & Outstanding] as string)) <> '' then i.[Issued & Outstanding] else b.[Issued & Outstanding] end as [Issued & Outstanding],
  case when i.[Comment] is not null and trim(cast(i.[Comment] as string)) <> '' then i.[Comment] else b.[Comment] end as [Comment],
  b.[Net Shares issued in Period] as [Net Shares issued in Period]
from {base} b
full outer join {increment} i
  on upper(trim(cast(coalesce(b.[Security ID],'') as string))) = upper(trim(cast(coalesce(i.[Security ID],'') as string)))
  and b.[As of Date] = i.[As of Date]
  and b.[Process Date] = i.[Process Date]
  and upper(trim(cast(coalesce(b.[Trans. Type],'') as string))) = upper(trim(cast(coalesce(i.[Trans. Type],'') as string)))
  and upper(trim(cast(coalesce(b.[Trans. No.],'') as string))) = upper(trim(cast(coalesce(i.[Trans. No.],'') as string)))
  and upper(trim(cast(coalesce(b.[Broker No.],'') as string))) = upper(trim(cast(coalesce(i.[Broker No.],'') as string)))
  and coalesce(b.[Shares Issued],0) = coalesce(i.[Shares Issued],0)
  and coalesce(b.[Shares Retired],0) = coalesce(i.[Shares Retired],0)
order by coalesce(b.[As of Date], i.[As of Date]), coalesce(b.[Process Date], i.[Process Date]), coalesce(b.[__workflow_row_number], 1000000 + i.[__workflow_row_number])

tasks.description: 按交易自然键（8 列）幂等合并 base 与增量：同键去重，增量非空覆盖 base（空值保留），按 As of Date / Process Date 升序输出固定 12 列。使用通用 sql.compute（full outer join）实现，等价于原 keyed.merge。
